title: Server
description: The host under load: CPU, load, memory, disk and network from node-exporter, with the compiles of clsi.

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: The 1 minute load average divided by the number of cores. Above 100% means tasks wait for a core.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Share of all cores. iowait is time spent waiting for the disk, steal is time the hypervisor took.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Tasks running or waiting for a core. Above the cores line, the host is overloaded.

panels.title: CPU of the busiest containers
panels.description: compile is the sandboxed compile containers that clsi starts. cAdvisor looks every 15 seconds, so very short compiles can be missed.
